column1: # Documented functions of gmodule/rel_debug_menu.prx (see re/documented.tsv for the columns; registry ids carry the module prefix, addresses here do not).

column3: summary

Module entry point: registers the scene with system_scene_register(0x34 start = system_debug_menu_scene_main, 0x264 end = system_debug_menu_scene_end, 0x8098a8, the module address just past its 8 MiB heap area) and returns 0. Side effects: scene slot callbacks. No direct caller (ELF entry point; the module serves scenes 0, 1 and 0x0c).

Scene start callback and main loop of the debug menu: sceKernelChangeCurrentThreadAttr(0, 0x4000), creates an 0x800000-byte heap on the module's own memory at 0x98a0 (system_heap_create, kept in 0x9890), hides the loading overlay, installs the frame callback system_debug_menu_draw_frame with leave callback 0xc4c (system_scene_set_frame_callback(1, ...)), sets font colour 0 and clears the state words; when the current scene transition (system_scene_get_transition) is all zero (the game booted straight into this scene) starts in state 0x5a (autoload), else state 0. Then loops once per frame (system_wait_frame) on the state word 0x9840: 0 fade-in, 1 menu, 2 run entry, 3 options, 4 save wait, 6/7 sound test, 8 idle, 0x5a/0x5b/0x5c autoload and card-info reload, 99 net duel test, 199 net card test; returns when a handler returns non-zero (it has called another scene). No return value. Side effects: heap, frame callback, all debug state. No direct caller (registered as the scene start callback by system_debug_menu_register_scene).
Empty function (jr ra). No side effects. No direct caller (registered as the scene end callback by system_debug_menu_register_scene).

Splits a frame count into out[0] = hours (frames / 108000), out[1] = minutes ((frames % 108000) / 1800) and out[2] = seconds ((frames % 108000 % 1800) / 30), i.e. play time at 30 frames per second. No return value. Side effects: writes out. Callers: 1 (system_debug_menu_draw_frame, with the word at save_get_state() + 0xc).

Frame callback of the debug scene: increments the blink counter 0x9854, starts libgu on layer 0 (system_ge_close_list_ehge_restart), clears colour/depth/stencil (sceGuClear 0x17), finishes the list (system_ge_open_list_ehge_sync), sets font scale 14 and prints the screen of the current state with system_font_printf: state 199 the net card test, 99 the net duel test, 0x5b and 4 the save utility dialogs (save_update_utility_dialogs), 7 the sound test (title, 10 rows of BGM/SE/character/variant/voice values, a bar of the current sound level, red text when a voice bank is not loaded, character name via world_get_character_name_string_first), 3 the 8-row option menu (current language name, region label), states 0-2 the menu title, the play time split from save state +0xc, up/down page markers and up to 15 entry names of the current menu table (second name pointer for non-Japanese languages); a cursor marker blinks with bit 3 of 0x9854. No return value. Side effects: GE list on layer 0, font drawing, 0x9854. No direct caller (frame callback installed by system_debug_menu_scene_main).

column2: void ui_list_window_draw_text(int x, int y, void *text)
column3: Same code as BOOT ui_list_window_draw_text: system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, (480 - x) << 6, text). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 1 (system_debug_menu_draw_frame).

Same code as BOOT system_ge_open_list_ehge_sync: n = sceGuFinish(), commits list base + n - 8 as the layer write pointer. The caller passes a source-file name and line (0x18a), which this copy ignores. No return value. Side effects: libgu context, layer write pointer. Callers: 1 (system_debug_menu_draw_frame).

Same code as BOOT system_ge_close_list_ehge_restart: selects display-list layer layer, records the write pointer as the list base and calls sceGuStart(2, base, space). No return value. Side effects: current layer, list base, libgu context. Callers: 1 (system_debug_menu_draw_frame, layer 0).
Empty function (jr ra). No side effects. No direct caller (leave callback passed to system_scene_set_frame_callback by system_debug_menu_scene_main).

Selects a menu table: menu, or the root table 0x9428 when NULL, is stored in 0x8098a0 and its entries are counted into 0x8098a4 (0x14-byte entries {name, name for other languages, handler, arg1, arg2}, at most 0x32, ending at a NULL first word); resets the cursor 0x9848 and top 0x9844. No return value. Side effects: 0x8098a0, 0x8098a4, 0x9844, 0x9848. Callers: 3 (system_debug_menu_fade_in, system_debug_menu_update_menu, system_debug_menu_open_submenu).

State 0: installs the root menu when none is set, then over 7 frames raises the fade counter 0x984c and sets the font colour (counter x 2 + 1) x 0x11111111 (a grey ramp to white); afterwards advances the state to 1. No return value. Side effects: menu table, 0x984c, font colour, state 0x9840. Callers: 1 (system_debug_menu_scene_main).

State 1 input (pad state +0x24 menu repeat, +0x1c pressed, +0x20 released): up/down move the cursor 0x9848 with wrap, left/right move by 15 entries (page) together with the top 0x9844, the top follows the cursor within 15 rows; R (0x200) opens the option menu (state 3), L (0x100) the sound test (state 7: audio_set_sound_heap(debug heap), resets its values, loads tracks 0x2c8-0x2cf); releasing the confirm button (system_get_confirm_button(0)) advances to state 2, or for entry 0xe goes to state 99 and initialises the net duel test; releasing cancel returns to the root menu. No return value. Side effects: cursor/top, state, audio heap and banks. Callers: 1 (system_debug_menu_scene_main).

State 2: while the fade counter 0x984c is positive decrements it and darkens the font colour; when it reaches 0 calls the selected entry's handler (word +8 of the 0x14-byte entry) with its arguments +0xc and +0x10, unless the handler is the module's offset 0 (no action). Returns 1 when the handler returned non-zero (it started another scene), else 0. Side effects: 0x984c, font colour, the handler's effects. Callers: 1 (system_debug_menu_scene_main).

State 3, an 8-item option menu (cursor 0x9848; R returns to state 1): on confirm (released) item 0 cycles the language 1-5 (save_set_language) and reloads card info (card_db_load_cardinfo, waiting for card_db_bind_cardinfo); 1 starts a new game (save_init_new_game), copies recipe 0 into the main/side/extra lists of members 0 and 1 (deck_set_member_slot_count/card), names member 0's deck after recipe 0, loads a cleared 0x858-byte duel set-up block (duel_setup_load_decks), save_set_setting_b1_bits3_4(2) and option flags 0 and 2 on; 2 fills the collection (system_debug_menu_fill_collection); 3 save_open(5) (save) and 4 save_open(4) (load), both to state 4; 5 starts a test duel: duel set-up buffer +0x188 = 3, +0x18c = 0, +0x190 = 5, +0x191 = 1, +0x192 = 1, +0x194 = 3, duellist 0 character 2 variant 0 recipe 1, duellist 1 character 4 recipe 0x15 (names and recipe decks copied), then system_scene_call(2, 6, 0) and returns 1; 6 opens the net card test (state 199); 7 switches back to Japanese (reloading card info and re-initialising the font on layer 4) and re-applies volume setting 2. Returns 1 only for the test duel, else 0. Side effects: save state, language, deck slots, duel set-up buffer, save sessions, scene change. Callers: 1 (system_debug_menu_scene_main).

State 4: steps save_update_task and, when it returns 3 or 2 (finished), resets state, cursor and fade counter to 0. No return value. Side effects: save task, state words. Callers: 1 (system_debug_menu_scene_main).

Sound test (states 6 and 7), 10 rows (cursor 0x9848): left/right change row 0 BGM track 0x985c (0-0x2f), 1 SE bank 0x9860 (0-7, bank 0x2c8 + n), 2 SE index 0x9864, 3 character 0x9868 (2-0x8e), 4 variant 0x986c (0-2), 5 voice bank offset 0x9870 (0-6), 6 voice index 0x9874 (below 0x35 for character category 1, else 0x91), 7-9 volume settings 0-2 (0-15, audio_set_volume_setting); when no direction is held the voice bank audio_get_voice_bank(character, variant) + offset is loaded (releasing the previous one in 0x9888 and waiting for audio_get_bank_data); square queues the duellist voice cues 0x71, 0x77, 0x78, 0x72, 0x7b, 0x7c for side 0 (duel set-up +0x1b8 = the bank), triangle stops duellist voices, cancel stops all sounds (fade 400), confirm plays the voice (row 6), the SE (row 2) or the BGM track (row 0); L returns to state 1 and restores the default sound heap. No return value. Side effects: audio banks, playback, volume settings, duel set-up words, state. Callers: 1 (system_debug_menu_scene_main).

State 0x5a: starts a save session with request 3 (autoload) on the debug heap (save_open(3, heap)) and advances the state to 0x5b. No return value. Side effects: save session, state. Callers: 1 (system_debug_menu_scene_main).
State 0x5b: steps save_update_task and goes to state 0x5c when it returns 2 or 3. No return value. Side effects: save task, state. Callers: 1 (system_debug_menu_scene_main).

State 0x5c: shows the loading overlay, card_db_load_cardinfo and waits (system_wait_frame) until card_db_bind_cardinfo succeeds, hides the overlay and sets state 0. No return value. Side effects: card info reload, overlay, state. Callers: 1 (system_debug_menu_scene_main).

State 99: runs system_debug_menu_net_duel_step; result 2 resets the fade counter and returns to state 0; result 1 clears the frame callback, shows the loading overlay, waits a frame and calls the duel scene (system_scene_call(0xd, 6, 0)) and returns 1. Returns 0 otherwise. Side effects: state, scene change. Callers: 1 (system_debug_menu_scene_main).

State 199: runs system_debug_menu_net_card_step with the same handling as the net duel test (result 2 back to state 0, result 1 system_scene_call(0xd, 6, 0) and return 1). Returns 0 otherwise. Side effects: state, scene change. Callers: 1 (system_debug_menu_scene_main).

Menu-entry handler: clears the frame callback, shows the loading overlay, waits one frame and calls scene with arg (system_scene_call(1, scene, arg)). Returns 1. Side effects: frame callback, overlay, scene change. No direct caller (handler word of a menu entry, called by system_debug_menu_run_entry).

Menu-entry handler: selects the entry's first argument as the new menu table (system_debug_menu_set_menu; the argument stays in a0, hidden by the decompiler, confidence medium) and returns to state 0 (fade-in). Returns 0. Side effects: menu table, state. No direct caller (handler word of a menu entry).

Debug collection set-up: sets the owned count of every card id 0xe88-0x1f39 to 0, clears member 0's deck and fills its main/side/extra lists from recipe 0, adding one owned copy per card; when the option cursor 0x9848 is 2 (always, since only item 2 calls it) adds 3 copies of every card id; for each character 0-0x8e that exists (variant 0) and can duel unlocks all its recipes (deck_get_owner_recipe, save_unlock_recipe, save_add_character_entry); sets character flag bit 2 for the (character, variant) of the 0xae character rows (world_get_character_key). No return value. Side effects: save collection counts, deck slot 0, recipe unlocks, character flags. Callers: 1 (system_debug_menu_update_options).
Returns 10^exponent (1 for 0) by repeated multiplication. No side effects. Callers: 1 (system_debug_menu_net_card_step).

Clears the 0xe98-byte net card test block 0x8098b4, initialises networking (system_net_init), clears the 0x6c-byte room info 0x80a048 and copies at most 15 units of the player name (save_get_player_name) to its +4. No return value. Side effects: those blocks, network library state. Callers: 1 (system_debug_menu_update_options).

Net card test, dispatched on system_net_api_get_manager_state: states 5, 7, 8, 9 set status 0x8098b4 = 0; 0x1e (in a room) status 3, member list into 0x809cb8, cross requests manager state 0x13; 0 requests state 4; -1 terminates networking (system_net_term) and returns 2; 0xb (lobby) status 1 with a card id editor: row 0x80a040 (up/down) 0 edits digit 0x80a744 (left/right, 0-3) of the id 0x80a748 with L/R subtracting or adding 10^digit (clamped to 0xe88-0x1f39), row 1 steps by card_db_get_sort_position (left/right) or by top-card group (L/R, card_db_get_top_group/top_card); START with a valid card sets room info +0x44 = 1 and +0x6a = the id and hosts a room (system_net_api_host_room(0x80a048)); cross requests manager state 0x21. Returns 0 otherwise. Side effects: test block, network manager state, room hosting. Callers: 1 (system_debug_menu_update_net_card).

Draws the net card test by status 0x8098b4: status 3 prints the card name (blinking, scale 16, ruby enabled for Japanese) and the 9 member entries (0x14-byte records at 0x809cb8, name at +0x14 or a placeholder) and reads the room counters; status 1 prints the digit carets (row 0), a row marker, the card id with printf and its name (card_db_get_name) or an unknown marker. No return value. Side effects: font drawing and font flags. Callers: 1 (system_debug_menu_draw_frame).

column2: void ui_debug_menu_draw_text(int x, int y, void *text)
column3: Same code as BOOT ui_list_window_draw_text: system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, (480 - x) << 6, text). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 1 (system_debug_menu_draw_net_card).

Clears the 0xe90-byte net duel test block 0x80a74c and initialises networking (system_net_init). No return value. Side effects: test block, network library state. Callers: 1 (system_debug_menu_update_menu).

Room-creation editor (status 0x80a74c = 2): cross cancels (0x80aedc = 0); START hosts the room described by the 0x6c-byte room info 0x80aee0 (system_net_api_host_room) and leaves the editor; up/down move the row 0x80aed8 (0-4); the room name +0x4a is set to a fixed ASCII string; left/right on rows 1-4 toggle +0x45 (1/2, tag duel), toggle +0x46 (1/2, single/match), cycle +0x47 (0-5, life points) and +0x48 (0-4, time limit). No return value. Side effects: room info, editor flag, room hosting. Callers: 1 (system_debug_menu_update_lobby).

Lobby (manager state 0xb): triangle (pressed) opens the room editor with defaults (+0x45 = 1, +0x46 = 1, +0x47 = 0, +0x48 = 0, player name at +4); while editing calls system_debug_menu_edit_room_rules; otherwise status 1, exchange step 0x80af4c = 0, cursor 0x80a750 (0-8) over the room list (system_net_api_get_room_list into 0x80a780, 0x6c-byte entries), circle joins the selected room when present (system_net_api_join_room with the player name and a fixed ASCII name), cross requests manager state 0x21. No return value. Side effects: room info, cursor, network manager state. Callers: 1 (system_debug_menu_net_duel_step).

Manager state 0x1e (status 3): up/down move the cursor 0x80a754 (0-8); otherwise reads the member list into 0x80ab50 and handles circle (system_net_api_toggle_ignore_member(cursor)), triangle (system_net_api_drop_unlisted_peers) and cross (manager state 0x13, status 0). No return value. Side effects: cursor, member list copy, network state. Callers: 1 (system_debug_menu_net_duel_step).

Manager state 0x15: sets the status word 0x0080a74c to 4, reads the host slots into 0x80ab50 (system_net_api_get_host_slots); newly pressed cross (0x4000 in pad word +0x1c) cancels with system_net_cancel_selected_peer. No return value. Side effects: status word, slot copy, network state. Callers: 1 (system_debug_menu_net_duel_step).

Data exchange of the net duel test (manager state 0x1f, status 7), step 0x80af4c, using a 0x200-byte packet at 0x80af54 (u8 +0 type, +2 phase, +3 ready, UTF-16 text at +4) sent with system_net_api_send_game_data: 0 sends type 1 phase 1 with the player name; 1 when all peers reached phase 1 (system_net_api_check_peers_sync(1, 4, 0xff)) copies each peer's name (0x30-byte slots at 0x80b154) and sends phase 2; 2 the host (peer 0) waits for sync(1, 2) and sends type 2, clients wait for the host's type 2; 3 left/right choose a recipe 0x80a77c (0-0x1cd), sending its name, until the local state is 2; 4 the host on sync(2, 2) and circle, or a client when the host step is 1, sends ready; local state 1 goes back, cross re-sends phase 1, triangle calls system_net_set_word_bafc(0); 5 loads the chosen recipe into a 0x100-byte buffer and sets up a block transfer into 0x400 bytes; 6 when system_net_api_exchange_data_blocks completes copies each peer's 0xc0-byte deck to 0x80b2d4 and frees the buffers; 7 sends type 0xd and waits 8 frames (8); 0xb fills the duel set-up buffer: +0x190 = 1, +0x192/+0x191/+0x196/+0x197 = the room's tag, single/match, life-point and time rules (from the own room or the selected room), +0x193 = 0, +0x194 = 3, +0x195 = 2; for each peer a 0x1ac-byte duellist record with name, deck name, deck, recipe code 0x1ce, peer index, character 1 for the local peer (whose deck is also copied to set-up +0, with card flags 4, or for recipe 0x1d1 member 0's own deck and the save card-list states) and 0 for others; in a tag duel the missing members 2-3 get character 2 with recipe 1. Returns 1 after step 0xb, else 0. Side effects: packets, heap, duel set-up buffer. Callers: 1 (system_debug_menu_net_duel_step).

Same code as BOOT system_net_copy_room_info: copies 6 bytes, 32 bytes from +6 and the u16 at +0x26 of a room info record. Returns dst. Side effects: writes dst. Callers: 1 (system_debug_menu_exchange_decks).

Net duel test dispatcher on system_net_api_get_manager_state: 5, 7, 8, 9 set status 0; 0x1f runs system_debug_menu_exchange_decks and returns its result; 0x23 status 6, cross requests state 0x13; 0xe-0x11 status 5, circle requests state 0xb; 0x15 joining; 0x1e room members; 0xb lobby; 0 requests state 4; -1 terminates networking and returns 2. Returns 0 otherwise. Side effects: those of the handlers, network manager state. Callers: 1 (system_debug_menu_update_net_duel).

For the five rule rows copies a label into a 64-byte local buffer: row 0 a fixed label, row 1 by +0x45 (1/2), row 2 by +0x46 (1 single, 2 match), row 3 by +0x47 (0-4: life-point values up to 16000), row 4 by +0x48 (0 no limit, 1-4: 30, 60, 180, 300 seconds); the buffer is never printed in the decompiled body (output probably compiled out; callers pass a second argument 5). No return value. No side effects. Callers: 3 (system_debug_menu_draw_room_rules, system_debug_menu_draw_members, system_debug_menu_draw_selected_room).

Lobby draw (status 1): reads the local MAC string, prints the blinking cursor at row 0x80a750 and for each of the 9 room entries (0x6c bytes at 0x80a780, present when +4 is set) its name (+8) and five rule bytes (+0x48..+0x4c), a name (+0x4e) and a state word (+0x40), or a placeholder. No return value. Side effects: font drawing. Callers: 1 (system_debug_menu_draw_net_duel).

column2: void ui_debug_menu_draw_text_b(int x, int y, void *text)
column3: Same code as BOOT ui_list_window_draw_text: system_font_draw_text(x << 6, y << 6, (480 - x) << 6, text). Side effects: text drawn. Callers: 4 (system_debug_menu_draw_exchange, system_debug_menu_draw_rooms, system_debug_menu_draw_members, system_debug_menu_draw_selected_room).

Room-editor draw (status 2): reads the local MAC string into 0x80b5dc (system_net_api_get_local_mac_string) and runs system_debug_menu_format_room_rules twice on the room info 0x80aee0; nothing is printed in the decompiled body. No return value. Side effects: writes the buffer 0x80b5dc. Callers: 1 (system_debug_menu_draw_net_duel).

Room-member draw (status 3): MAC string, room rules, blinking cursor at row 0x80a754 + 7, then for 9 member entries (0x14-byte records at 0x80ab50: present +4, flag +8, index +0xc, name +0x14, text +0x46) the index + 1, name and text, or a placeholder. No return value. Side effects: font drawing. Callers: 1 (system_debug_menu_draw_net_duel).

Joining draw (status 4): MAC string, room rules, then the selected room (system_net_api_get_selected_room): its name at (0x78, 0x6c), five rule bytes and a text, plus a fixed message line. No return value. Side effects: font drawing. Callers: 1 (system_debug_menu_draw_net_duel).

Exchange draw (status 7) for steps 3-5: in step 3 prints the local recipe choice (deck_get_recipe_name(0x80a77c)); then for each peer its number, its name slot (0x80b154 + 0x30 x i) and, when the peer's packet phase byte is 2, the recipe name it sent (copied into 0x80b214 + 0x30 x i), else a blinking waiting marker. No return value. Side effects: font drawing, the recipe-name slots. Callers: 1 (system_debug_menu_draw_net_duel).

Draw dispatcher of the net duel test on the status 0x80a74c: 1 room list, 2 room rules, 3 members, 4 selected room, 5 and 6 fixed message lines, 7 data exchange, 0 nothing. No return value. Side effects: font drawing. Callers: 1 (system_debug_menu_draw_frame).
